mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.3%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 1% for three consecutive months indicates a contraction in industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE over a quarter indicates job creation without wage inflation, suggesting a benign labor market expansion that supports corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over a quarter
regime_hint: labor market expansion with stable wages
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above 12-month MA
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.7%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% during a period of negative GDP growth signals an emergency easing, which boosts liquidity and supports risk assets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND GDPC1 YoY < 0 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1.0%) in at least 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in INDPRO above 2% for four consecutive months signals a robust industrial expansion, which raises earnings expectations and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.6%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes across all regimes.
